remarks: Sunny and inviting one-bedroom, one-bath apartment ideally located in the heart of downtown Stamford. This bright residence offers a comfortable layout with abundant natural light, perfect for both relaxing and working from home. Heat, hot water, and cooking gas are included-adding exceptional value and convenience. One reserved parking space is included, a rare find in this prime location. The building also features a communal laundry room for residents, conveniently located on the main level. Just moments from shops, restaurants, transportation, and all that downtown Stamford has to offer, this apartment combines comfort, practicality, and unbeatable location. A great opportunity for easy city living-schedule your showing today!
